full_character.name: Thalia Nereon
full_character.personality_description: A steady priest who treats gods as dangerous neighbors rather than distant ideas.
full_character.speech_style: Gentle, ceremonial, and very direct when danger rises.
starting_known_facts: Thalia Nereon is present at the start and can explain the immediate situation.
Thalia Nereon should be useful without taking choices away from the player.
Thalia Nereon has a clear stake in the first objective.
Thalia Nereon can recur if the player keeps involving them.

world_flags.tone: Simple mythic quest with one shrine, one offering, and clear supernatural stakes.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Blue light spills from the old star basin in the shrine courtyard.

Thalia Nereon presses a wrapped offering into your hands and looks toward the sky, where one dark patch has opened among the stars.

(Thalia Nereon) "Carry this up the hill path. Do not promise anything you cannot give."
